options.label: Walk from Hosidius
options.directions: Head south-west to the Woodcutting Guild.

options.label: Walk from Digsite
options.directions: Take the barge to Fossil Island and follow the island route to the named location.

options.label: Walk from Yanille / Camelot
options.directions: Follow the local map to the named creature location. Use its linked map for the precise spawn or entrance.

options.label: Sail to Ynysdail
options.directions: Dock on the island north of Gwenith and use the cavern entrance. Check the island guide for the Sailing requirement.

options.label: Lumbridge Swamp shed
options.directions: Enter the shed with a dramen or lunar staff. Follow the Zanaris map to the creature.

options.label: Fairy ring network
options.directions: Use a fairy ring to reach Zanaris, then follow the location map.
requirements: Fairy rings unlocked, with a staff or the applicable diary reward

options.label: Walk from Port Tyras
options.directions: Head south through the swamp to Zul-Andra. Speak to the priestesses before taking the sacrifice boat.

options.label: Zul-andra teleport
options.directions: Arrive in Zul-Andra and speak to the priestess before boarding.
